methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Octavia operates in Robotics & Manufacturing at an undisclosed stage. The comparable universe consists of one public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. This sector-level universe is constrained: while ten same-sector peers exist, none cluster sufficiently around Octavia's stage, adjacent stage, or valuation tier to support a reliable peer-median approach.

The peer-median method is not applicable. A granular screen for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables yielded fewer than three datapoints in each category, the minimum threshold for meaningful triangulation. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial bias given stage and valuation dispersion across the nine total comps. The single public company provides limited inference without clarity on Octavia's specific positioning relative to that benchmark.

Without sufficient narrow-set comparables, traditional multiples-based valuation cannot be reliably anchored. The analysis does not support a triangulated valuation range at this time. Key uncertainties include Octavia's exact developmental stage, capital deployed to date, and revenue or growth metrics relative to the identified peer set. A narrower comparable set at Octavia's specific stage—or quantitative data on unit economics and deployment scale—would be required to establish a defensible valuation conclusion.
